story.title: Bold's Story
story.p1: Born in Mongolia, raised in Paris. Khuselbold Amartuvshin grew up between two worlds — the steppes of Central Asia and the bistros of the 18th arrondissement. This duality shapes his vision: a borderless gastronomy, rooted in excellence and authenticity.
story.p2: Years spent in the kitchens and dining rooms of Paris's finest establishments gave him total mastery of the restaurant chain — from concept to plate, furniture to front-of-house. Bold Design is that expertise distilled into objects and concepts.
story.p3: Today, he creates premium tabletop accessories, develops innovative restaurant concepts, and carries the ambition to export this know-how to his ancestral land: Mongolia.
story.quote: "Every object in a restaurant tells a story. I want that story to be beautiful."
story.mission: Improve every dimension of the restaurant experience — the object, the space, the service, the food — through design and innovation.
story.mongolia: Bold doesn't only dream Paris. He carries the project of transforming the Mongolian gastronomic scene, bringing Parisian standards from street food to haute cuisine.
